notes: Model pilot (sonnet arm; the same pole is tested independently by the other arm, pairing disclosed): this pole feeds the held pole bonsai1/L35/N3415+ (zeroing this neuron removes 0.63 of the anchor's peak), from a batched edge measurement with 8 same-layer placebos. Label and all 16 sentences written by the Sonnet 5.5 labeller from a packet (card + all-pole band samples + the edge hint) and one probe round of 8 sentences (none reused). An Opus gate checked rule-level items only and edited nothing. Labeller's note: Probes: only the explicit French ' conf' piece cleared 0.3 (0.68); pure prediction contexts (reply to... to, further re) stayed 0.16-0.36 and one near miss hit 0.36, so the label is the piece rather than prediction. Mixed evidence, hence low confidence.
